panels.title: CMTC operations · observed intent and inventory
panels.description: Visible context and scope; documented status is not a live health metric.

options.content:
**Observe mode:** namespace selection, existing enrollment labels, node inventory and controller activity are live. **Enforcement verification is unavailable.** These readings do not establish workload protection.

Use the cluster selector for one cluster or both. Blue identifies cmtc-a; red identifies cmtc-b in charts and table cells. [Workload mTLS evidence](https://github.com/ephico2real2/clustermesh-trust-controller/blob/1c192a5ee84fb5218cb1385fdd9c5bf45ca69e1a/2026-10-24T0509Z-local-authenticated-only-f052d127/README.md) is a separate isolated trial.

panels.title: Controllers reporting
panels.description: Latest controller metric series at range end, one per reporting controller. Not application or datapath readiness.

panels.title: Node inventories ready
panels.description: Latest successful local inventory observations at range end. Not encrypted or protected node counts.

panels.title: Namespaces selected · intent
panels.description: Latest namespace selection intent at range end. The Observe controller does not change labels or enforce traffic.

panels.title: Enforcement verification
panels.description: Native CMTC capability gauge at range end. Zero means verification is unavailable in Observe mode; missing telemetry remains unavailable.

panels.title: Enrollment labels observed
panels.description: Latest namespaces carrying the Cilium enrollment label from any actor. Label presence is intent, not protection.

panels.title: Non-platform namespaces observed
panels.description: Latest non-platform namespace inventory, including explicitly excluded namespaces; not a count of safe-to-enroll namespaces.

panels.title: Namespace decisions · latest share
panels.description: Latest namespace decisions at the selected range end. Selected, excluded, platform and unselected are disjoint and sum to all observed namespaces in the selected clusters. This is inventory/intent, not mTLS coverage. Missing telemetry stays unavailable.

panels.title: Namespace decisions by cluster
panels.description: Latest namespace decision gauges at range end, one row per cluster and decision. Zero is an observed empty category; a missing controller is not zero.

panels.title: Read the namespace categories
panels.description: Visible context and scope; documented status is not a live health metric.

options.content:
**Selected** = policy intent. **Excluded** = explicit exclusion. **Platform** = protected infrastructure. **Unselected** = remaining namespaces.

The pie includes platform namespaces in its denominator. Non-platform inventory includes excluded namespaces. Enrollment labels are observed from any actor. None of these counts proves mTLS or Protected status.

panels.title: Do controllers and node agents keep up?
Metrics targets reachable
panels.description: Latest successful scrapes at range end. The two-cluster lab expects six: two controllers plus four node agents. Filtered views have fewer targets. Read the target table for individual failures; this count is not an all-healthy verdict.

panels.title: Controller reconcile errors/s
panels.description: Controller-runtime reconcile errors per second over the adaptive rate interval. An observed zero means no recorded errors; missing data is unavailable.

panels.title: Policy evaluations/s · by cluster
panels.description: Successful CMTC policy evaluations per second over $__rate_interval. A fall to zero can mean idle work; it is not protection readiness. Missing metrics remain unavailable.

panels.title: Controller reconcile p95 · seconds
panels.description: 95th-percentile controller-runtime reconcile duration from real histogram buckets, over $__rate_interval. It measures controller work, not network or TLS latency. No observations mean the percentile is unavailable.

panels.title: Pod inventory by node
panels.description: Latest node-local pod inventory at range end. pod and host classify network mode. Counts are not protected pods or successful platform probes.

panels.title: Metrics targets · current state
panels.description: Latest Prometheus target reachability at range end, with authoritative scrape cluster/component/node labels. UP does not establish workload or certificate readiness.

panels.title: Inventory and controller telemetry boundaries
panels.description: Visible context and scope; documented status is not a live health metric.

options.content: Rates use the adaptive scrape/zoom interval; lines start at zero, with solid blue cmtc-a and dashed red cmtc-b. Tables show the latest observations at range end. **hostNetwork inventory is not platform safety.** API, DNS, probe health, certificate rotation and layered encryption still require their own verified instrumentation.

panels.title: What is still awaiting security qualification?
Implementation status · documented scope, not live health
panels.description: Visible context and scope; documented status is not a live health metric.

options.content:
| Capability | Current evidence boundary |
| --- | --- |
| Namespace intent / node inventory | Live CMTC telemetry above; Observe remains read-only |
| Workload mTLS / native DENY | Tested in the isolated two-node SPIRE fixture; see the separate mTLS evidence |
| Persistent strict admission / authorization | Missing-policy, first-packet, finer caller permissions and restart/revocation gates remain open |
| CA trust / rotation / remote identity | Public SVID validation demonstrated locally; rotation, issuer faults and cluster identity isolation remain open |
| ClusterMesh / WireGuard / IPsec | Observe ClusterMesh baseline tested; cross-cluster workload mTLS and transport composition remain unqualified |
| Kubernetes / OpenShift platform safety | Platform namespace exclusion implemented; required traffic/probe checks remain separate gates |

**Missing security metrics are unknown.** No invented handshake, protected-pod, trust-ready or transport-success numbers are substituted. Planned panels below retain every original domain; their metrics will be implemented as the agile stories progress.

panels.title: Can workloads be verified as protected? · planned
Verified cluster gates · planned
panels.description: Planned instrumentation; missing data means not implemented, never success. All required verified cluster gates satisfied for the current generation and freshness window. Mapped status/table; no sum that hides one failed or missing required gate. Proposed labels/source must be qualified in the delivering story. Metric contract: cmtc_cluster_ready

panels.title: Pods protected · planned
panels.description: Planned instrumentation; missing data means not implemented, never success. Eligible current pods with fresh verified mandatory capture, identity and destination enforcement. Latest state count/table; no inference from enrollment or ACK. Proposed labels/source must be qualified in the delivering story. Metric contract: cmtc_pods_protected

panels.title: Pods awaiting enforcement · planned
panels.description: Planned instrumentation; missing data means not implemented, never success. Eligible current pods awaiting one or more required enforcement gates. Latest state count/table; exclusive with protected/failed states. Proposed labels/source must be qualified in the delivering story. Metric contract: cmtc_pods_pending

panels.title: Pods enforcement failed · planned
panels.description: Planned instrumentation; missing data means not implemented, never success. Current eligible pods in a failed enforcement state, not cumulative failure events. Latest state count/table; never rate() this gauge. Proposed labels/source must be qualified in the delivering story. Metric contract: cmtc_pods_enforcement_failed

panels.title: Platform dependency health · planned
panels.description: Planned instrumentation; missing data means not implemented, never success. Latest fresh platform dependency check, with a bounded dependency label. Mapped table/status history per required dependency; missing dependency cannot pass aggregate readiness. Proposed labels/source must be qualified in the delivering story. Metric contract: cmtc_platform_dependency_healthy

panels.title: API probe result · planned
panels.description: Planned instrumentation; missing data means not implemented, never success. Latest fresh safe API connectivity/TLS probe result. Mapped latest state/history; not application mTLS or cluster-wide health. Proposed labels/source must be qualified in the delivering story. Metric contract: cmtc_apiserver_probe_success

panels.title: Rollouts aborted/s · planned
panels.description: Planned instrumentation; missing data means not implemented, never success. Aborted rollout events with bounded reason/profile labels. Aborts/s or selected-range increase; distinguish current rollout state. Proposed labels/source must be qualified in the delivering story. Metric contract: cmtc_rollout_aborted_total

panels.title: Are enrollment and node configurations drifting? · planned
Enrollment label drift/s · planned
panels.description: Planned instrumentation; missing data means not implemented, never success. Detected enrollment-label drift episodes under a defined deduplication boundary. Event rate/range increase; not the number of namespaces currently drifting. Proposed labels/source must be qualified in the delivering story. Metric contract: cmtc_namespace_label_drift_total

panels.title: Node configuration drift/s · planned
panels.description: Planned instrumentation; missing data means not implemented, never success. Detected node desired/applied configuration drift episodes. Event rate/range increase; current drift is a distinct status. Proposed labels/source must be qualified in the delivering story. Metric contract: cmtc_node_config_drift_total

panels.title: Proxy configuration ready · planned
panels.description: Planned instrumentation; missing data means not implemented, never success. Fresh proxy-process/configuration readiness at a stated boundary. Mapped table/status history; proxy readiness alone does not establish Protected. Proposed labels/source must be qualified in the delivering story. Metric contract: cmtc_ztunnel_ready
